links.comparator_used: GPT-4 general explanations without an 8th-grade readability instruction
links.outcome: Readability, understandability, and accuracy of patient-facing explanations of glomerular disorder therapies
links.effect: Readability improved from 12.85 ± 0.93 to 8.44 ± 0.72; FRE increased from 25.73 ± 6.98 to 60.75 ± 4.56; PEMAT-P increased from 60.7% to 76.8% (p < 0.0001 for both); accuracy decreased from 4.56 ± 0.66 to 3.99 ± 0.39 (p < 0.0001).
links.quote: The accuracy of GPT-4's tailored explanations was significantly lower compared to the general explanations (3.99 ± 0.39 versus 4.56 ± 0.66, p < 0.0001).
